payload.core_mechanism_summary: Left-to-right greedy removal using a stack: whenever current char is 'B' and top is 'A' or 'B', pop; else push. This eliminates all removable substrings.
payload.rationale: The algorithm greedily removes any possible 'AB' or 'BB' immediately, which is optimal due to an exchange argument: any valid sequence can be transformed to an equivalent one starting with this removal without increasing final length.
